summary: Chelan County L-5 cab built 1934 in Wenatchee National Forest, removed in the 1970s; Willhite describes foundation and remains; reached by trail from Leavenworth.

facts.design: L-5 cab; the sources read mention a cab and no tower
facts.status_note: Removed in the 1970s; Willhite's photo captions mention a foundation, remains and an anchor spike

staffing.status: John (Johan) Olav Kjosness worked summers as a lookout on several Leavenworth-district stations, French Ridge among them, from 1934 through 1939; Ralph Walter is listed as lookout personnel in 1963; no schedule found

access.note: Reached by a hiking trail from Leavenworth; no source read describes a closure or a permit

visit.trail_note: From Leavenworth, Icicle Creek Road to the trailhead, then Icicle Creek Trail 2 miles and French Ridge Trail 4.4 miles (Willhite; hiking distance 6.5 miles, gain 3,500 feet). A 2003 trip report says the side trail to the site is easy to miss.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Willhite's summary table says 'Access: Any vehicle', but the route text describes a hike of about 6.5 miles from the trailhead at the end of Icicle Creek Road. The story follows the route text.

notes_for_editor: Built, removal and location agree across the four sites that describe the lookout. The brief's 'ground' kind fits: the sources describe a cab and mention no tower, so no correction is proposed. Staffing is personnel only (a 1934-1939 blog naming Kjosness and a 1963 firelookout.com entry naming Walter); no fires or schedule found. Today's condition rests on Willhite's photo captions, not on a written description, and one caption is dated 2020. The 2003 trip report is the only other visit account. The Leavenworth Echo quotes are reached through Forest Lookouts and Willhite, not the newspaper itself. No photos added.
